blocks.text: Verses 10–13 use the earth’s fruitfulness and a joyful going out to picture renewal. One disputed reading places these images within Isaiah 40–55’s message of comfort and return from Babylon, where creation and exodus imagery portray a new homecoming. This reading does not require the passage to suggest that the trauma of displacement or later conflict simply vanished.

The Great Isaiah Scroll is an almost complete manuscript witness to all sixty-six chapters of Isaiah. It broadly aligns with the Masoretic tradition, while also containing thousands of spelling and substantive differences. Other Isaiah manuscripts and interpretive writings from Qumran show that the book was actively copied and interpreted.
